definitions.gloss: supporting an entire group; being a fan of all members
definitions.explanation: In idol and entertainment fandom, the practice of supporting and cheering for an entire group or unit rather than having a single favorite member. The term comes from thinking of the group as a 'box' (unit) to support.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{箱推|はこお}しです。
examples.english: I'm a fan of the whole group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{推|お}し→推す：12798_osu⟧メンはいない⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、{箱推|はこお}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I don't have a favorite member, but I support the whole group and like everyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧だった⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{箱推|はこお}しになった。
examples.english: At first I was a fan of just one member, but now I support the whole group.

notes:
USAGE:
Originated in Japanese idol fandom culture and has spread to other fan communities. Contrasts with {単推|たんお}し (supporting a single member) or having a ⟦{推|お}し→推す：12798_osu⟧メン (favorite member). The ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box) metaphor refers to the group as a whole unit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {箱推|はこお}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to support the whole group)
- {箱推|はこお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧ (a fan of the whole group)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{推|お}し→推し：04736_oshi⟧: one's favorite (person, group, or thing to support)
- {単推|たんお}し: supporting a single member
- ⟦{推|お}し→推す：12798_osu⟧メン: favorite member (of an idol group)
